"""Validate/install skill; publish regression audit and closed negative model evidence."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl, importlib.util, json, re, shutil
B=Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-strata-upstream-sync-skill-20261013')
O=Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/feat-prefill-gated-region-alias-20261013')
S=W/'skills/strata-upstream-sync'; I=Path('/home/yayoi/.codex/skills/strata-upstream-sync')
F=W/'bench/results/2026-10-13-upstream-sync-skill-and-regression-audit'
creator=Path('/home/yayoi/.codex/skills/.system/skill-creator')
sp=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('skill_publish_owner',B/'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(sp);sp.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(sp.origin)=='a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
def load(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def safe(v,key=''):
 if isinstance(v,dict):return {k:safe(x,k) for k,x in v.items()}
 if isinstance(v,list):return [safe(x) for x in v]
 if isinstance(v,str) and key!='sha256' and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}',v):return dict(sha256=v)
 return v
def dump(p,v):p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_text(json.dumps(safe(v),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
def archive(p,t):dump(t,dict(path=str(p),sha256=m.sha(p),text=p.read_text()))
with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
 fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
 out=B/'main-upstream-sync-skill-publication-root-v2';assert not out.exists() and not F.exists() and not I.exists();out.mkdir()
 env=load(B/'main-prefill-gated-region-full-build-root-v2/record.json')['environment']
 r=dict(active=True,passed=False,complete=False,commands=[],evidence={},gpu_executed=False,main_reviewed=True,previous_goal_turn_classification='progress: actual repeated12K rejected64K without GPU fault; recovered verified historical layer-major speedup and source-line loss; new skill authored and forward-evaluated')
 def save():(out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
 owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save);r['commands']=owner.commands
 def run(label,args,allowed=(0,)):
  print('SKILL PUBLICATION '+label,flush=True)
  c,so,se=owner.run(label,args,env,W,wall=300,cpu=1800,rss_cap=3<<30,text_cap=8<<20,total_cap=32<<20)
  r['evidence'][label]=dict(stdout=so.read_text(),stderr=se.read_text());save()
  assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed,label
  return so.read_text().strip()
 try:
  assert run('head',['git','rev-parse','HEAD'])=='6035c4f92bf87362d7e55051ae1375b9befba89e'
  assert not run('local-identity',['git','config','--local','--get-regexp',r'^user\.(name|email)$'],(1,))
  run('author-identity',['git','var','GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
  closed_path=B/'main-prefill-gated-region-12k-repeated-model-root-v2/record.json';closed=load(closed_path)
  assert closed['complete'] and not closed['active'] and not closed['passed'] and closed['expected_guard_rejection'] and 'error' not in closed
  assert all(m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] for c in closed['commands'])
  assert [q['prompt_tokens'] for q in closed['requests'] if q.get('complete')]==[1024,32768,32768]
  assert closed['requests'][3]['prompt_tokens']==65536 and not closed['requests'][3]['complete'] and closed['requests'][3]['admission_rejected']
  assert closed['model-hashes-after']['complete'] and all(not v['fault_entries'] and not v['dump_present'] for v in closed['kernel_checks'].values())
  assert closed['capacity_guard']['requested_peak_bound']==4383187712 and closed['capacity_guard']['fresh_free']==4355325952
  r['closed_model_receipt']=dict(path=str(closed_path),sha256=m.sha(closed_path),original_passed=False,complete=True)
  skillfiles=[p for p in S.rglob('*') if p.is_file()];assert {str(p.relative_to(S)) for p in skillfiles} == {'SKILL.md', 'agents/openai.yaml', 'references/integration.md', 'references/evaluation.md'}
  pins={str(p.relative_to(W)):m.sha(p) for p in skillfiles};r['skill_source_pins']=pins;save()
  run('skill-validator',['/usr/bin/python3',str(creator/'scripts/quick_validate.py'),str(S)])
  outputs=run('skill-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',*sorted(pins)]);assert 'skipped (' not in outputs
  # This installed copy is the reusable artifact, not a resume backup.
  shutil.copytree(S,I)
  assert all(m.sha(I/p.relative_to(S))==m.sha(p) for p in skillfiles)
  run('installed-validator',['/usr/bin/python3',str(creator/'scripts/quick_validate.py'),str(I)])
  r['installed_path']=str(I);r['installed_pins']={str(p.relative_to(S)):m.sha(I/p.relative_to(S)) for p in skillfiles};save()
  old_text=run('historical-paired-summary',['git','show','d0c5dda0:bench/results/2026-10-05-sycl-prefill-scaling/layer-major/paired-normal-wall/summary.json'])
  old=json.loads(old_text)
  assert old['tokens']==32768 and len(old['pairs'])==6 and abs(old['median_tokens_per_second']['layer-major']-645.8479513721903)<1e-9
  genealogy=run('source-selection-merge',['git','show','--no-patch','--format=%H%n%P%n%s','c3aa33ae'])
  assert 'f8478f4e4d6ec9e7d0b9fe32fe3ea0808771483a e8ca9afd03d839d4f8dbbe82dffce7f8a3bafd7a' in genealogy
  # Select a retained historical source proof; never invoke its model binary.
  previous_source=run('old-layer-major-source',['git','show','f263d87d:sycl/src/prefill/prefill.cpp'])
  assert 'run_layer_major' in previous_source and 'STRATA_PREFILL_LAYER_MAJOR_R_GPU' in previous_source
  assert all(token not in (O/'src/prefill/prefill.cpp').read_text() for token in ('run_layer_major','STRATA_PREFILL_LAYER_MAJOR','STRATA_PREFILL_RELEASE_CACHE'))
  F.mkdir()
  dump(F/'historical-paired-summary.json',old)
  reports=['research-runtime-usm-pool-physical-accounting-round392-v1.txt',
   'implementation-serve-first-row-logits-capture-v1.txt','implementation-phase-gated-quality-capture-integration-v1.txt',
   'research-historical-performance-regression-round394-v1.txt','research-historical-performance-regression-round394-v2.txt',
   'research-upstream-inference-merge-regression-round395-v1.txt','research-upstream-inference-merge-regression-round395-v2.txt',
   'evaluation-strata-upstream-sync-skill-v1.txt','evaluation-strata-upstream-sync-skill-v2.txt']
  new=[]
  for name in reports:
   t=F/'research'/(name+'.json');archive(B/'research-20261009'/name,t);new.append(dict(path=str(t.relative_to(F)),sha256=m.sha(t)))
  prior=O/'bench/results/2026-10-13-gated-region-alias-diagnostics/report-registry-v192.json';assert load(prior)['research_completed']==939
  dump(F/'report-registry-v193.json',dict(research_completed=948,prior=dict(path=str(prior),git_revision='6035c4f92bf87362d7e55051ae1375b9befba89e',sha256=m.sha(prior)),new_reports=new,main_only_test_execution=True,main_corrections='R394/R395 v1 had insufficient historical scope. v2 recovers old layer-major winner and source-line loss; both originals retained. Forward tester suggestions to make all features optional or abandon requested multi-agent repetition are rejected as contrary to user instructions; scope/bounds/unsupported upstream/full-context evidence clarifications accepted.'))
  extracted=load(B/'main-session-speed-statements-audit-v2.json')
  moments={'2026-10-03T08:16:19.507Z','2026-10-05T08:32:29.114Z','2026-10-05T11:21:36.069Z','2026-10-13T00:00:48.880Z','2026-10-13T07:39:16.578Z'}
  chosen=[v for v in extracted['statements'] if v['timestamp'] in moments];assert len(chosen)==5
  dump(F/'session-statements-selected.json',dict(original_extract_path=str(B/'main-session-speed-statements-audit-v2.json'),original_extract_sha256=m.sha(B/'main-session-speed-statements-audit-v2.json'),parsed_statements=409,selected_user_facing_statements=chosen,v1_parser_wrong_channel_returned_zero=True,v1_not_promoted=True,scope='User-facing historical statements only; authoritative paired result is independently read from Git, not inferred from chat.'))
  compact={k:v for k,v in closed.items() if k!='evidence'};compact['evidence']={}
  for label,e in closed['evidence'].items():
   if label=='engine-phase-lifetime':
    lines=[v for v in e['stderr'].splitlines() if re.search(r'phase-|head-lease|prefill scratch alias|prefill gated alias|configured=|FAILED|ZE_RESULT_ERROR|ERROR',v)]
    compact['evidence'][label]=dict(stdout=e['stdout'],stderr_progress=lines)
   elif label.startswith('kernel') and '-cursor' not in label:compact['evidence'][label]=dict(summary='Cursor/fault filter/counts retained in kernel_checks; unrelated cumulative journal omitted.')
   else:compact['evidence'][label]=e
  dump(F/'repeated12k-receipt.json',dict(original_path=str(closed_path),sha256=m.sha(closed_path),record=compact))
  archive(B/'main-prefill-gated-region-12k-repeated-model-v2.py',F/'controllers/repeated12k.json')
  archive(B/'main-upstream-sync-skill-publication-v1.py',F/'controllers/skill-publication-v1.json')
  archive(B/'main-upstream-sync-skill-publication-v2.py',F/'controllers/skill-publication-v2.json')
  failed_path=B/'main-upstream-sync-skill-publication-root-v1/record.json'
  failed=load(failed_path);assert not failed['passed'] and not failed['complete'] and not failed['active']
  dump(F/'publication-v1-preflight-failure.json',dict(original_path=str(failed_path),sha256=m.sha(failed_path),record=failed,main_review='Controller incorrectly expected5 skill files; actual named set has4. It stopped before lint/install/cleanup/Git publication. Original failure retained.'))
  dump(F/'forward-evaluation-fixture.json',load(B/'main-upstream-skill-forward-evaluation-fixture-v1.json'))
  summary=dict(skill='strata-upstream-sync',installed_path=str(I),source_pins=pins,frontmatter_valid=True,source_lints_passed=True,installed_validator_passed=True,forward_evaluations=2,mandatory_non_engine_all_features=True,inference_component_level_only=True,unchanged_upstream_benchsh=True,standalone_upstream_box_and_tuned=True,keep_fork_better_components=True,preserve_existing_best_routes=True,part_specific_prefill_decode_decisions=True,old_layer_major_paired_median_tps=old['median_tokens_per_second'],historical_rate_not_same_current_workload=True,lost_old_layer_major_route_verified=True,source_selection_boundary='c3aa33ae1c2d9827dca19bbf53731b3c092094b0',later_v0143_server_merge_not_layermajor_deletion=True,decode_direct_regression_unproven=True,repeat12k_complete_requests=[1024,32768,32768],repeat12k_65536_rejected=True,repeat12k_original_passed=False,repeat12k_observation_complete=True,repeat12k_fresh_free=4355325952,repeat12k_required=4383187712,repeat12k_fault_count=0,quality_qualified=False,full_physical262144_qualified=False,performance_samples=[],candidate_adopted=False,research_completed=948,next_step='Restore lost layer-major scheduling in a separately reviewed current-API implementation or reproduce its exact historical recipe safely; keep superior fork components. Validate production fixed-prefix capture separately; actual updates follow installed skill, no claim of1000/70 attainment.')
  dump(F/'summary.json',summary)
  ja='''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# 上流更新スキルと性能履歴の確認

strata-upstream-sync を作成し、個人の Codex skills にインストールしました。
本家・XeStrata の未変更単体を箱出しと環境に適した設定で測定し、非推論機能を全件
対応表で取り込みます。推論は役割・量子化・shape・個別部品で判断し、fork が優れる
部品を保持します。prefill の利益で decode の退行を隠しません。上流 bench.sh を使い、
既存の最良設定と呼び出し経路、個別結果、反復調査、256KとRESTOREの範囲を記録します。
validator と文書・秘密情報・ライセンス検査を行い、synthetic fixture の独立評価を
2回受けました。これは実上流の測定や統合ではありません。ユーザーの必須機能全件と
複数エージェント反復指示を optional に変える提案は採用せず、scope、実行不可の上流、
bounded search と最大入力の実消費証拠に関する明確化を反映しました。

この session の履歴を確認し、PR #6 の paired-normal-wall を Git から読み直しました。
32768入力、8192 chunk、context65538、3組交互比較で中央値453.2935から645.848 t/s。
全248320 logits と出力の一致を伴う有効な過去記録です。現在の標準benchとは入力、
時計、context/KV、出力長等が異なるため退行率を単純計算しませんが、古い値を棄却しません。
PR #8 の約520/533/540は64Kの単発・計測付き観測として保持します。

旧 layer-major は層ごとに全入力chunkを処理し、expertの再転送を減らします。
現在のroot srcにはその経路がありません。旧実装はsycl/配下の別topic commitで、
c3aa33aeのsource系統選択で使われるroot engineに引き継がれませんでした。
後のv0.1.43サーバー移植でこの部品を削除したという証拠ではありません。
R394/R395初版は過去の調査範囲が不足していました。元を保持し、v2で訂正しました。
短いcontextのIQ3_S decode18.30と現在の長文・MTPなし8前後も条件が違い、
decodeの直接の退行は未確定です。新しい移植候補と以前の最良構成を再比較します。

12K候補の繰り返しでは1024、32768、32768入力を完了しました。その後の65536要求は
要求4383187712 bytesに対し空き4355325952 bytesで、workspace確保前に拒否しました。
元結果はpassed=falseを維持し、観測はcompleteです。後続GPUと全モデルhash確認は
通り、faultはゼロです。64K完走、品質、全物理262144、速度改善の証明にしません。
閉じた重複ログだけをmanifestに沿って削除し、元statusを変更せずcompact evidenceを
commitしました。registry v193は948件です。目標1000/70 t/sは引き続き未達です。
'''
  en='''<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->

# Upstream sync skill and recovered performance history

Created and installed strata-upstream-sync in personal Codex skills. It evaluates
pristine standalone upstreams with box defaults and tuned settings,imports every
non-inference feature through a coverage table,and selects inference by role,
quantization,shape and individual component. Keep better fork components and do
not hide decode regression with prefill gains. Use upstream bench.sh,retain best
settings/call paths and individual samples,and repeat research/context checks.
Validator,document/secret/license checks and two independent synthetic forward
evaluations were completed. This is no real upstream measurement or integration.
Suggestions to make all features and requested parallel research optional were
rejected; scope,unsupported upstream,bounded search and consumed-context evidence
were clarified.

Session history led to PR#6 paired-normal-wall reread from Git:32768 inputs,8192
chunk,context65538,three alternating pairs,medians453.2935 to645.848 t/s,with full
248320-logit and output equality. This is valid historical evidence. Current stock
bench differs in input,timing,context/KV and output horizon; do not compute a direct
regression ratio or discard the old result. PR#8 rates520/533/540 remain single,
instrumented64K observations.

Old layer-major processes every input chunk per layer and reduces expert reloads.
Current root src lacks that route. The old sycl/ topic was not carried into the
root-engine lineage selected at c3aa33ae; the later v0.1.43 server port is not the
shown deletion. Preserve the insufficient-scope R394/R395 v1 reports and their
v2 corrections. Short-context IQ3_S decode18.30 and current long,no-MTP values
near8 differ in conditions; direct decode regression remains unproven.

Repeated12K completed1024,32768,32768 inputs,then refused65536 before workspace
allocation:4383187712 requested against4355325952 free bytes. Preserve passed=false
and complete observation. Following GPU/full-model hashes passed,fault count0.
This proves no64K completion,quality,full physical262144 or speed gain. Retire only
closed duplicate logs through the manifest,preserve original statuses and commit
compact evidence. Registry v193 holds948 reports. The1000/70 t/s target remains open.
'''
  (F/'REPORT.ja.md').write_text(ja);(F/'REPORT.md').write_text(en)
  deletions=[]
  for c in closed['commands']:
   for kind in ('stdout','stderr'):
    p=closed_path.parent/'commands'/(c['label']+'.'+kind)
    if p.exists():
     assert p.read_text()==closed['evidence'][c['label']][kind] and m.sha(p)==c['logs'][p.name]['sha256']
     deletions.append(dict(path=str(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size,sha256=m.sha(p),replacement=str(F/'repeated12k-receipt.json'),reason='Closed duplicate stream; immutable original JSON retains exact bytes and failed status; compact progress/results committed'))
  # Chat-extract copies are closed investigation working data, not independent archives.
  for name in ('main-session-speed-statements-audit-v1.json','main-session-speed-statements-audit-v2.json','main-upstream-skill-forward-evaluation-fixture-v1.json'):
   p=B/name;deletions.append(dict(path=str(p),bytes=p.stat().st_size,sha256=m.sha(p),replacement=str(F/'session-statements-selected.json' if 'audit' in name else F/'forward-evaluation-fixture.json'),reason='Closed evaluation input/extract superseded by independently verified Git history and selected evidence; original session is untouched'))
  manifest=dict(owner='Main',deleted=False,deletions=deletions,original_model_receipt_retained=True,original_session_untouched=True,byte_budget=4<<20,consumer='Lost layer-major recovery and next upstream sync; serve capture source qualification',next_review='After same-workload schedule comparison and production capture qualification',active_runs_touched=False)
  dump(F/'retention-manifest.json',manifest)
  files=[str(p.relative_to(W)) for p in F.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]
  output=run('report-lints',['/bin/bash','tools/lint/run.sh',*files]);assert 'skipped (' not in output
  run('diff-check',['git','diff','--check'])
  assert all(m.sha(W/p)==v for p,v in pins.items()) and m.sha(closed_path)==r['closed_model_receipt']['sha256']
  for row in deletions:assert m.sha(row['path'])==row['sha256']
  for row in deletions:Path(row['path']).unlink()
  manifest.update(deleted=True,removed_files=len(deletions),removed_logical_bytes=sum(v['bytes'] for v in deletions));dump(F/'retention-manifest.json',manifest)
  run('stage',['git','add','--','skills/strata-upstream-sync',str(F.relative_to(W))])
  run('commit',['git','commit','-m','feat(skills): evaluate upstream components and preserve faster fork paths'])
  r['commit']=run('committed-head',['git','rev-parse','HEAD'])
  run('push',['git','push','-u','origin','feat/strata-upstream-sync-skill-20261013'])
  assert not run('status',['git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'])
  r.update(passed=True,complete=True,removed_files=len(deletions),removed_logical_bytes=sum(v['bytes'] for v in deletions))
 except BaseException as error:r['error']=repr(error)
 finally:r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc());save()
 print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ('passed','error','commit','installed_path','removed_files')}),flush=True)
 raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
